answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 10913 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., Imam told Takbira Taharima and after some times (i.e)1 or 2 minutes (before going ruku in 1 Rakat) I came and joined in Jamath. My query is whether I need to recite Sana or not? Question: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., Imam told Takbira Taharima and after some times (i.e)1 or 2 minutes (before going ruku in 1 Rakat) I came and joined in Jamath. My query is whether I need to recite Sana or not? Answer ID: 10913 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 225/224=M/1430) One should recite sana if one finds time to do so provided the imam is not doing loud recitation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
